30 Story templates, ready in Canva. Stories are for people who already know you, and they're where warm people decide to buy. Each template is 4 frames: question or problem → proof or demo → answer or result → the ask. Use one sticker per frame, keep the link sticker inside the safe zone, and use urgency only when it's true.
  1. Tap Open in Canva, then Use template. Free Canva works, and you get your own copy.
  2. Type over the words. The blue notes tell you what to write.
  3. Replace the photos with yours: select one, then Replace.
  4. Blue boxes mark where an Instagram sticker goes. Add the real sticker in the Instagram app.
  5. Delete everything blue, then download as PNG (1080 × 1920, 9:16).

Example businesses are illustrative. Each template's ideas PDF shows it filled in for 8 kinds of business.

★Weekly Reel seriesReach + Trust

Bonus Reel template, 1080 × 1920. One named show, same look every week, a new episode each time.

Open in CanvaIdeas for 8 businesses (PDF)

Canva link not opening? Download the PowerPoint file and drag it onto canva.com on a computer.

What each page does:

  1. Cover: series name, episode number, this week's title. Keep the words in the middle so your grid doesn't crop them.
  2. First 2 seconds: your clip + this episode's hook.
  3. The useful part: the one thing to remember.
  4. Next episode: when it comes out and what it's about.

Each week: duplicate your design and change only the title, number and clips. Download page 1 as PNG for the cover and pages 2 to 4 as one MP4. In Instagram, post the MP4 as a Reel, then Edit cover → Add from camera roll.

Did it do its job? Look at follows, saves, and people asking for the next episode.
